questions.q: What is the minimum sea surface temperature needed for a tropical cyclone to form?
questions.why: Warm water of at least 27°C provides the evaporation and heat energy that fuel the storm.

questions.q: Why do tropical cyclones not form on the equator?
options: The Coriolis force is too weak to make the air spin
Wind shear is always too low
questions.why: The Coriolis force is weakest at the equator, so rising air does not start to spin.

questions.q: Which of the following is a SECONDARY impact of a tropical cyclone?
options: A storm surge flooding the coast
questions.why: Disease is a later effect caused by the primary impacts such as flooding.

questions.q: Explain why prediction and preparation reduce the impacts of tropical cyclones.
questions.model: Satellites and storm tracking give days of warning, so people can be evacuated to shelters. Stronger building design and defences reduce damage, so fewer people are killed.
points: tracking/forecasts give warning so people can evacuate
building design / shelters / defences reduce damage and deaths
